hero.subtitle: Automotive • React Native
hero.title: TapCar
hero.tagline: Car sharing app for trusted circles: family, friends, colleagues. No third-party telematics — direct integration with the vehicle's built-in systems.

seo.title: TapCar — React Native car sharing without third-party telematics
seo.description: P2P car sharing for Norway: direct OEM integrations, BLE, Node.js backend.

overview.title: About the project
overview.description: TapCar (Tapcar AS, Norway) — car sharing service for closed groups. The owner shares their car with selected people. The app manages vehicle access, booking, and cost calculation — no additional hardware installation needed.

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: React Native mobile app + Node.js backend.

features.title: Direct vehicle integration
features.description: Connects to the manufacturer's built-in telematics without third-party dongles. BLE device as fallback when OEM servers are unavailable.

features.title: Access management and booking
features.description: Owner creates a group of trusted drivers. Availability calendar, time-slot booking, push notifications.

features.title: Automatic cost splitting
features.description: Algorithm distributes costs between participants based on mileage and usage.

impact.title: Outcome
impact.description: App published on the App Store (Norway). Supports multiple car brands. Last update — June 2023.

achievements.title: Live product
achievements.description: Published on the App Store with real users in Norway

achievements.title: Zero hardware installation
achievements.description: Works through built-in telematics — nothing to mount in the car
